The forms अभ्युत्सादयामकः प्रजनयामकः चिकयामकः रमयामकः पावयांक्रियाद् विदामक्रन् are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: छन्दस्

The affixes छ (ईय), यत् (यं) and ख (ईन) come in the sense of 'who is able to go' after the word अभ्यमित्र।

Terms: छ (ईय), यत् (यं) and ख (ईन)

There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel of ह्वा in the reduplicated form, in both the syllables.

Terms: लिट् लकार

The acute accent falls on the first syllable of the reduplicate verbs when followed by an affix beginning with a vowel (the vowel being not नुट्) and being a सार्वधातुक Personal-ending.

Terms: accent-तिङ्

इवङ् and उवङ् are substituted for the इ and उ of a reduplicate, before a non-homogeneous vowel.

Terms: इवङ्-उवङ्

A guttural is substituted for the ह् in हन् 'to kill' after reduplication also.

Terms: Guttarlisation

The चर् is also substitute of झल् letters occuring in a reduplicate syllable, as well as जश्।
